_readme: SpeakLoop dark color scheme, the default. Selected with 'color_theme': 'dark' in config/settings.json; restart to apply. Keys starting with '_' are ignored. A missing key falls back to the built-in dark palette in speakloop/config.py, which holds these same values. Copy this file into config/themes/ to edit it without touching the installation.
_surfaces: Backgrounds and borders. bg_main is the window, bg_panel the chat and the status bar, bg_accent the accent-tinted fill of the idle mic button. accent is the brand purple of the title and the focus highlight.
_text: text = chat body, text_emph = the partner's reply, text_bright = the learner's own line and the mic glyph, text_dim = secondary labels (stats, instruction), text_muted = [System] lines.
_status: Status line and mic outlines. partner marks everything the dialogue partner says or does.
_mic: Mic button per-state inner fill; the outlines reuse accent, bad, warn and good.
